icons.subject: the GINZA LION emblem without the GINZA text: a star between two rampant lions raising beer mugs, with LION below
icons.color: two tones: the logo brown #241613 on a white circle
icons.note: Traced from the GARDEN TERRACE LION logo image (394px): the emblem was enlarged 8x, its outlines followed at the 170/255 gray level and simplified, and the star replaced by a 10-point polygon through the traced tips. The site owner chose to use the official logo without permission; this is the exception in section 4.4 of the food guide spec.

promptTemplate: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: tiny food-place map icon. Generate one original flat pictorial icon: {subject}. Color palette: {color}. Transparent background. Square composition, one centered large bold silhouette filling 85 percent of the image; very thick simple shapes, crisp edges, readable at 16 pixels. Consistent friendly geometric vector-like style. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand emblems, no decorative border, no pin shape, no shadows, no gradients, no realistic detail. This is a temporary generic icon for an unofficial campus map, not an official brand logo.
